notes.title: Small adjustment/fix + Controller Support
notes.content:
[p]Season 2 Level 14 - got rid of the tricky collectible at the end of the level, since too many people were stuck there.  

Fixed the 2 levels where the music wasn't muted even if you set it on mute.  

The game now supports controllers.  I used an Xbox controller to map the inputs but it seems to work with other controllers as well through "steam input" that you will have to enable. [/p]

notes.title: Adjustments
notes.content:
[p]I adjusted some things around the game based on your feedback and fixed some bugs.

- the lil pihs from the Season 4 Boss in No Death mode could still kill the player, that's fixed now
- added extra checkpoints throughout the game
- fixed jumps throughout the game
- I made most of the season 2 level 14 a lot easier
- re-worked season 3 level 13 (the whole level is smaller and no more confusing portals)
- made season 2 boss a lot easier ( way fewer flying pihs are being spawned during fight )

[/p]

notes.title: Small Fixes
notes.content:
[p]This update fixes some small bugs such as:

- season 4 boss collision improvement
- flying monster hog improvement in season 4, the punch should be more accurate when it comes to this enemy
- changed Season 1 Level 20 a bit ( I deleted the parts of the walls that needed to be destroyed, since a lot of people couldn't find the last items and it wasn't obvious that you have to destroy the walls to find them)
- fixed the collision in season 4 level 6 for the banister when you go up the stairs, before you could fall through it, now it blocks you and protects from falling

I am going through all the levels and looking for improvements that I can do, so expect another update in the near future.

Thank you all for playing!

[/p]

notes.title: Optimization Patch
notes.content:
[p]This optimization patch lowers the total size of the game by ~ 5GB.   

I optimized the textures in all levels one by one, which makes a huge difference.  

For lower end PCs/laptops you should also see a performance improvement.  

Thank you all for the support, new updates are coming as always! [/p]

notes.title: Reason For The Name Change
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I realized I only posted the reason for the name change on social media and not on Steam.

This is what's been going on for a while ( it wasn't an easy decision to make ):

1. TikTok and Instagram algorithms were flagging my content because they think the word pi(g) is used as an insult. This resulted in having 2 strikes on each platform, which means that I will get banned at a 3rd strike, 

2. I already tested this, and for the past 2 -3 months since I stopped using the name of the game in title or comments the game has gone viral. Also, I am spending too much time approving comments that just mention the game name (because the platforms think it's an insult) and I could use that time making the game better, 

3. I am planning a console launch and I don't want to deal with the same issues from a marketing perspective, the game is nothing to be flagged for so I will not risk it. 

4. WinterMG and other streamers have helped the game tremendously and I am thankful for that, I also want to make sure no streamers in the future will have to deal with any issues just because they play my game and the algorithm is weird.

Nothing has changed in the game.

notes.title: Sound Settings, Car Levels Checkpoints and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This patch includes Sound Settings, Car Levels Checkpoints and several bug fixes:

1.Speedrun timer fix for boss levels ( it used to show 00:00,00, now it's fixed)
2.Speedrun timer added under the NoDeath mode medals
3.Some platforms were not going back and forth (so if you miss them you have to restart the level), but now they are.
4. Medal for S1L1 Medium is fixed now and it shows properly in Level Select (S1)
5. S2L4 music is looping properly now
6. No Death Mode had a sound issue, the death sound was playing and overlapping each time you got hit, now it doesn't
7. The lion pihs in S3L6 in the beginning of the level weren't running back after killing the player, which would result in a continuous loop of death if you got killed by the spawn point, now it's fixed.


As always, let me know if you encounter any new issues, and I will fix them, thank you all for the support!

notes.title: S2 Level 14 Small Update
notes.content:
I removed a few collectibles that were being missed by people playing on easy or very easy mode. Players were getting to the end of the level, which is already a huge task, just to see that  they miss 2-3 collectibles. 

That was happening because they were blending in with the background so I decided to just remove those, and now all the collectibles are being picked if you stay on the main path ( for those 2 difficulty modes).

notes.title: Introducing: Abilities and Medals
notes.content:
Introducing: Abilities and Medals
I am excited to show this new update! 

There are some new features along with some re-hauling of the original systems.

Medals:
-difficulty based
-track progress 
-stack points (use points for power-ups in the future updates, currently your points are being saved in the back-end)

Abilities:
-add-ons to your current gameplay features
- Slo-mo: allows you to slow the game speed 
- Ice Bullet:  allows you to freeze pigs when you shoot them (doesn't work on boars)



OG Players will get the silver medal by default, on all the levels that they played.
*There is a system that will let OG players add their previous medals manually, just by renaming some files in the game folder. If you finished the game ( or just some levels ) in different difficulty modes,
please contact me so I can make sure you get your medals.

You can dm me on any of these platforms, and I will explain how to add your medals.
